items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: his wife Sylvia had asked me if I knew one of the tunes from “Kismet,” “Stranger in Paradise.”

ctx.x: Like you can never know all of them it seems like.

It’s impossible. As a matter of fact I occasionally play with a great guitarist named Peter Leitch. He has a regular Sunday night gig in New York at a place called Walker’s. Just a duo. And every week he has somebody different. And I do the gig like every couple of months and it’s good for that because Peter knows a million tunes in any key, and he knows these obscure tunes that nobody knows, all of these different Broadway tunes. So just last week I played with him again and I remember the time before that his…

Right. I sometimes feel sorry for the bass players at sessions. For one thing they have to play forever, plus it seems to me as a horn player you can kind of — well you don’t have to know the roots all the time. You can negotiate with your ear somewhat. But the bass player, I hope he knows the changes.
